title: Maple's new face
kaylee: Maple looks like a storybook beaver: a big happy grin with two white front teeth inside it, kind brows, a little shiny nose, chubby cheeks, a light tummy and dark paws.

pictures.title: Talking in a film
pictures.caption: The grin opens under her teeth now, not above them

pictures.title: Her face
pictures.caption: White teeth in a pink-tongued grin, brows, a smaller shiny nose, chubby cheeks

pictures.title: All of her
pictures.caption: A light tummy and dark brown paws, like the reference; no hat or vest
